statement: A point-in-time financial QA system reports that plain hybrid RAG leaks temporally invalid evidence at a rate of 10.8%, which as-of enforcement reduces to 1.7%, with answer accuracy rising from 66.7% to 78.9% and hallucination falling from 17.3% to 7.9%; the setup assumes a query as-of date and treats evidence as valid only once it has become public.

evidence.quote: improves answer accuracy from 66.7% to 78.9% over hybrid RAG while reducing temporal evidence leakage from 10.8% to 1.7% and hallucination from 17.3% to 7.9%
a disclosure may support a query only after becoming public
Given a question, company, and as-of date, the framework enforces the information boundary defined by U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) filing availability
